published_dependency_check.scope: Selected versions; PyPI release metadata and PyTorch hash-verified wheel metadata; default extras on Windows CPython 3.13.14

uv.verification: Official release checksum text and API asset digest agree

python.verification: Pinned uv download catalog and Python Build Standalone API asset digest agree

limitations.details: Official PyTorch index and wheel HEAD responses do not publish archive SHA256 for these selected versions. Lock hashes come from archive_info.hashes.sha256 in the existing ComfyUI portable installation records; they were not independently compared to downloaded archives. Download must fail closed on a mismatch. Official wheel URLs and core metadata checksums were verified.

No runtime archives, wheels or model weights were downloaded. No isolated fresh install, CUDA execution, image generation or video generation was performed. Metadata closure cannot prove binary/runtime compatibility.

isolation_guidance.notes: Keep these environment variables process-local. Clear inherited package index/mirror/source overrides without logging values before invoking uv. Use a dedicated project .venv; never run sync against an unrelated environment.

wheel_availability_check.method: HTTP HEAD only; no wheel bodies downloaded

lock_validation.syntax: PEP 508 named direct URL plus pip/uv hash option
